[P2] Close newly created executors when constructor validation throws

If the factory returns an executor with prestarted workers and its `isShutdown()` throws, the exception escapes this constructor without shutting down the pool. `DurableExecutor.execute()` has not acquired its try-with-resources manager yet, so neither `close()` nor `shutdownOwnedExecutor()` runs, leaving live workers behind after the failed invocation. Guard initialization with ownership-aware cleanup that shuts down the newly acquired executor and releases any acquired lease, while leaving executors rejected as already leased untouched. Add a regression test for a throwing initial state query.
